methods.title: Exact FCC tetrahedral slice transport and Euler face-holonomy checker
inputs: four oriented regular-tetrahedral FCC slice normals
six declared FCC unoriented line families
outputs: cross-normal recovery of all six shared line families
methods.arithmetic: exact integer and Fraction vector/quaternion algebra
boundaries: the FCC atlas is a selected classical carrier/readout, not the native P000 six-dimensional identity
the spherical face-area interpretation uses standard classical sphere normalization
no global factorization theorem for every native six-dimensional Cell trajectory is claimed
no identity with the tetrahedral residual C2, immediate-reversal bit, or Pell shell sign is claimed
